shortDescription: Ramona Nee fielded offers from several rivals, including Simpson Thacher, according to people familiar with the matter. "Partner Who Was Poised to Lead Weil Gotshal Is Joining Kirkland & Ellis," at 12:51 p.m., incorrectly said she had an offer from Ropes & Gray.
